recipe.summary: Two mechanisms, one per lane, and the record keeps them apart. The codex lane is closed BY CONFIG: agent_specific.sandbox=workspace-write (+ web_search=false) closes the shell network end to end while the model call still completes (executed, with a positive control under the shipped danger-full-access default). KAPSO's DEFAULT lane is the claude lane, which has no lane-level network switch: banning Bash closes it by deleting the tool the coding lane exists to use, so that lane needs an external network barrier (`docker run --network none` / `--network <internal>`, or `unshare -rn`) or a switch to the codex lane. Closure is therefore a property of the RUN (lane choice + barrier), not of the shipped config.
